title: fix(plugin-auth)!: with SSO domain verification on, a provider creates an account only for an email address at a domain it has proven
body:
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` teaches SSO domain verification or account creation through an SSO provider; `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx` ("Domain verification (opt-in)") states the rule.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:开启 SSO 域名验证后,身份提供方只能为“该提供方已验证的域名”下的邮箱新建账号;子域名只有自身被列出并验证才算;提供方的域名条目必须写成裸主机名(如 `acme.com`)才算已证明;邮箱的域名部分必须本身就是该域名的唯一写法。其余一律以 `EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED` 拒绝,且不写入任何用户、账号、成员或会话。
- 为什么改:让“域名验证”真正兑现其承诺:验证的是域名,新建账号就必须落在已证明的域名上;代码注释与文档对这一保证的描述同步更正。
- 风险与回滚:仅在开启域名验证的环境生效;已有账号不复查、账号关联不变、关闭验证的环境不变。首次以子域名或其它域名登录的用户会被拒,需把该域名加到提供方并重新验证;域名条目写成网址或带端口(`https://acme.com`、`acme.com:443`)的提供方需改写为 `acme.com` 并重新验证。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/sso-account-at-proven-domain.ts`(规则本体,重点看 `oneSpelling`、`provenEntryHost` 与 `refuseSsoAccountOutsideProvenDomain` 的失败即拒);`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-auth-instance.ts`(`validateUserInfo` 的串接位置,先于受众规则判定);`.changeset/sso-account-only-at-proven-domain.md`(BREAKING 与 Who moves)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/sso-account-at-proven-domain.test.ts`,预期 `Tests  25 passed (25)`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(ADR 文本 #32951 为 Tier H,需受管审批;它替换了 #32638)。

## What changes

With SSO domain verification on, a provider creates an account only for an email address at a domain it has proven.

- **The rule** (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/sso-account-at-proven-domain.ts`, new). For `action: 'create-user'` from an SSO-provider source (SAML or OIDC), with `AuthManager.isSsoDomainVerificationEnabled()` on, the address's domain must equal one of the provider's verified domains.
  - **Verified domains:** the entries of the provider's comma-separated `sys_sso_provider.domain`, if and only if `domain_verified` reads on (`true` or `1`; one flag covers the whole list).
  - **An entry counts only for the host the provider proved:** it must already be written as a bare host name (letters, marks, digits, `.` and `-`, one trailing root dot allowed) in its one spelling. An entry written any other way (a URL, a port, a path, a user part, an escape) proves nothing; the list's other entries still count.
  - **The address's domain** is everything after its last `@`, and it must already be a bare host in its one spelling. The one spelling is the bare lower-case ASCII host `providerDomains` parses the list into; an internationalised name written in Unicode counts when its punycode form reads back exactly as written (`bücher.de` and `xn--bcher-kva.de` are one domain). A host that only folds into a spelling (full-width letters, a variation selector, a trailing dot, a numeric shorthand) is refused.
  - **Equality only:** a subdomain counts only when it is itself listed and verified; a parent never counts for a listed child.
- **Fail closed.** No engine, no row, a row for another provider, a failed read, or a `domain_verified` that is not `true`/`1`: no verified domain, refused. The refusal reuses the ledger code `EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED` with a rule-level description that names no domain. No new error code.
- **Where.** Chained into better-auth's `user.validateUserInfo` in `auth-manager-auth-instance.ts`, judged first and on its own: no audience posture, `allowJit`, pending invitation, bootstrap carve-out or operator ticket relaxes it, and the audience gate must still admit. `AuthInstanceHost` gains `isSsoDomainVerificationEnabled` (the same decision as the plugin list's `ssoDomainVerification`).
- **Unchanged.** Verification off; accounts that already exist (not re-checked); linking; the cloud IdP and enterprise generic-OAuth providers (`method: 'oauth'`).
- **Texts that state the guarantee, corrected:** the `domainVerification` comment in `auth-manager-plugin-list.ts`, the TSDoc of `isSsoDomainVerificationEnabled` (`auth-manager.ts`), the routing paragraph in `sso-provider-lifecycle.ts` (routing is not admission), and `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx` (what verification decides, how to write an entry, and the `allowJit` paragraph). The ADR-0135 design text is corrected in a separate draft PR, so this fix does not wait on that approval: #32951 (it replaced #32638).
- **Changeset:** `@objectstack/plugin-auth` patch, `!`, BREAKING paragraph with "Who moves" (outside-domain and subdomain first sign-ins; entries written as a URL or with a port or path; re-verify after editing the list), ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

## Tests

- `sso-account-at-proven-domain.test.ts` (new, 25 tests): the one spelling (case, punycode against Unicode); a domain part that only folds into a spelling (full-width letters, a variation selector, a trailing dot) has no domain; a domain part that is not already a bare host has no domain; an entry counts only for the host the provider proved, and a good entry beside one that proves nothing still counts; verified domains only when `domain_verified` is `true`/`1` (none for off, `0`, `null`, `'1'`, missing; refused for `false`, `0`, `null`, `'1'`); refused with no row, a row for another id, a source naming no provider, a throwing reader (one `warn`), no engine; equality only; CONTROLS for verification off and for sources the rule does not judge.
- `sso-oidc-refusal-cause.test.ts`, new describe "with SSO domain verification on, an OIDC provider creates an account only at a domain it has proven" (20 tests), and `sso-saml-refusal-landing.test.ts`, its SAML twin (19 tests), on the real `AuthManager` + `sso()` harnesses with verification on, `domain_verified` on and `allowJit` on: admitted at the single listed domain and at the second entry of a list; refused for another domain, a subdomain, a parent, a look-alike, an asserted email that is not an address, a domain part with a port, one with a path, a trailing dot, full-width letters, and an address at a listed entry not written as a bare host, each asserting `error=EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED` and no `sys_user` / `sys_account` / `sys_member` / `sys_session` written; the same domain in another case or in punycode admitted. No carve-out: the first human of a deployment at an outside domain, and an outside-domain address holding a pending invitation (JIT off), are refused. OIDC also pins that the IdP's `email_verified` claim does not mark the created account verified.
- CONTROLS: a provider whose domain is not verified signs nobody in (labelled: stays green under ablation, the vendor refuses it first); verification off creates the outside-domain account as today; an existing linked account at an outside domain still signs in; `invite_only` without `allowJit` still answers `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED` for an on-domain stranger.

## Acceptance notes

- The bare-host checks are allowlists (letters, marks, digits, `.`, `-`) and the comparison is equality in one spelling, so a check can only refuse more, never admit more.
- A stored entry written as a URL or with a port proves nothing here. Keeping such entries counting would need a second host parser kept in step with the vendor's; that choice is with the maintainer, and this PR ships the narrower rule, which only refuses.
- A second, weaker parser of the same provider domain list lives in `scim-sso-adoption.ts`. Left unchanged here; reported to the seat.
